units.rawText: I once picked up a plush doll on the battlefield. It had stitches where it had been fixed and its stuffing had been well-worn. Clearly, its owner had loved it very much. I'm sure it must have wanted to go back to its owner too.

units.rawText: That's why, to this day, I've been taking care of it in its owner's place. I'm sure that someday, it will return to its owner's side and keep them company, just like... just like how I'm keeping you company too, Professor.
